name: Rookie
description: Everyone starts somewhere. Welcome to the road.

name: Learner
description: Reach player level 3 and answer 50 questions.

name: Road Smart
description: Reach 50% mastery in 3 categories and clear 3 map locations.

name: Hazard Hunter
description: Clear 4 map locations and reach 50% mastery in 6 categories.

name: Intersection Expert
description: Reach 70% Intersections mastery and clear 5 map locations.

name: Road Rules Pro
description: Reach player level 10, clear 7 locations and 60% mastery in 10 categories.

name: Test Ready
description: 60% mastery in every category and 10 map locations cleared. Unlocks the Ultimate NSW Learner Test.

name: NSW Road Master
description: Pass the Ultimate NSW Learner Test and earn your Virtual Learner Licence.
